cells.gaps: No source found says how users sign in to the national portal, whether by the national ID or by one account shared across ministries. Use figures after April 2024 have not been found.
cells.note: The minister published 899,394 logins in a year and over 1.4 million registered users of the National e-Government Portal in April 2024 (ZAF-007). A published count of users meets stage 5, and a later yes answers the earlier questions.
